_comment: P2-050 (UIPOSES lane, 1 Nov 2026). GPU item score 28 Oct 5.88: Oskar, Halda and Lark all stand in the same arms-down idle with no role gesture, so the posts read as placeholder spawns. When enabled, each named villager's stance layers bone-local euler offsets (degrees) over the playing idle (scripts/characters/post_stance.gd, a SkeletonModifier3D attached by village_npcs.gd), so breathing still shows. Signs measured on the installed humanoid rig with an isolated render: ForeArm -X bends the elbow forward; Arm Y turns the forearm across the body. Presentation only; no collider, prompt, dialogue or save change. OFF until GPU judging.

beaten_trainer_stance._why: P2-065 (GPU 6.12): the bridge grunt and the Warden stand in the same neutral pose before and after defeat while the banner carries the change. When enabled, a beaten trainer keeps the dejected stance (head bowed, back rounded) once the defeat reaction hands off to the stand-down (trainer_npc.gd). +X bows Spine/neck/Head on this rig (isolated render). OFF until GPU judging.

immediate_1104._why: NEAR6-MS (4 Nov 2026), F38#29 P2-065 (board 5.51): VIS-MEADOWS r1b judged the slump arms flat because the after-victory frames still showed the grunt upright; the dejected stance only attached after the 7 s hold and the last victory line, after the shots. When enabled, trainer_npc.gd::_play_defeat_reaction attaches this deeper bow (spine, neck and head) the moment the trainer is beaten, so it shows during the victory lines and the stand-down. Presentation only. OFF until judged.
